description: Create an ohmyho.st project. Dev is included by default; set include_development_environment to false for Prod only, or add Dev later with project_development_add. When Dev is included, choose protected (default) or public access; public means anyone with the Dev URL can open it. data_mode defaults to shared; isolated separates database/Auth records and files. Later changes use project_data_plan and project_data_change; ohmyho.st never copies data and ordinary usage prices apply. region defaults to us; new databases, files and builds use the selected us or eu region. The customer API cannot change region later. ohmyhost.yaml storage.jurisdiction must match the recorded R2 jurisdiction; read project_context_get rather than guessing. Deploy to Dev then promote the reviewed artifact, or deploy directly to Prod when authorized.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: project_create
